## How to engage with “SLPresElection” the first time ?

``` r

## Installing the package from GitHub
devtools::install_github("Amalan-ConStat/SLPresElection")

## Installing the package from CRAN
install.packages("SLPresElection")
```

## Key Phrases

- Presidential Election
- District
- Electorate
- Postal Votes
- Displaced Votes
- Total No of Valid Votes (Total Valid)
- No of Rejected Votes (Total Rejected)
- Total No of Votes Polled (Total Polled)
- No of Registered Electors (Total Registered)

``` r

#Load necessary packages
library(SLPresElection); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); 
library(viridisLite); library(ggthemr); ggthemr("flat dark")
```

## What does “SLPresElection” ?

The eight presidential election results of Sri Lanka from 1982 to 2019
are available in the election commission [website as pdf
files](https://elections.gov.lk/web/en/elections/elections-results/presidential-elections-results/).
However, through pdf scraping these results are available as csv files
because of [my pet
project](https://github.com/Amalan-ConStat/PresidentialElection). These
csv files are available as data-frames in this R package.

Something to ponder on the tables in these pdf files

1.  Total Polled = Total Valid + Total Rejected
2.  Total Valid = Votes casted to Candidate $`A`$ + $`...`$ + Votes
    casted to Candidate $`Z`$
3.  Total Polled $`%`$ = (Total Polled/ Total Registered) \* $`100`$
4.  Total Valid $`%`$ = (Total Valid/ Total Polled) \* $`100`$
5.  Total Rejected $`%`$ = (Total Rejected/ Total Polled) \* $`100`$
6.  Candidate $`i`$$`%`$ = (Candidate A/ Total Polled ) \*$`100`$

## Data preparation articles

Eight vignettes describe the extraction and preparation of the
presidential election datasets for 1982, 1988, 1994, 1999, 2005, 2010,
2015, and 2019. They document count corrections, percentage
calculations, missing-value handling, and label harmonisation where
applicable. The 2019 article also includes the initial OCR prompt,
corrections to missing and misplaced result tables, and the
registered-elector discrepancies retained in the data.

``` r

# List the available package vignettes
browseVignettes("SLPresElection")

# Open the 2019 data preparation article
vignette("election-2019", package = "SLPresElection")
```

## Just a glimpse

``` r

Election1982 %>% 
  subset(ColNames=="No of Registered Electors" & Electorate=="Final District Results"| 
         ColNames=="Total No of Votes Polled" & Electorate=="Final District Results")  %>% 
  group_by(District,ColNames) %>%
  summarise(Votes=sum(Votes)/100000) %>%
  ungroup(District,ColNames) %>%
  ggplot(.,aes(x=District,y=Votes,fill=ColNames,label=round(Votes,4)))+
  ylab("Votes (in 100,000)")+xlab("District")+
  geom_col(position = "dodge")+
  geom_text(vjust=-1,size=3)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust=1.2,hjust=1.1))+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()+
  ggtitle("For 1982 the registered and polled votes for all districts")
```

![](reference/figures/Registered_and_Polled_Votes-1.png)

``` r

Final_Data<-rbind.data.frame(Election1982,Election1988,Election1994,Election1999,
                             Election2005,Election2010,Election2015,Election2019)
years<-unique(Final_Data$Year)
```

``` r

Final_Data %>%
  subset(ColNames=="No of Registered Electors" & Electorate=="Final District Results" | 
           ColNames=="Total No of Votes Polled" & Electorate=="Final District Results") %>%
  group_by(Year,ColNames) %>%
  summarise(Votes=sum(Votes)/100000) %>%
  ungroup(Year,ColNames) %>%
  ggplot(.,aes(Year,Votes,color=ColNames,label=Votes))+
  ylab("Votes (in 100,000)")+
  geom_point(size=3.5)+geom_line(linewidth=2)+
  geom_text(vjust=-1.25,size=4)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = years)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+scale_color_viridis_d()+
  ggtitle("The registered and polled votes for all eight elections")
```

![](reference/figures/Registered_and_Polled_Votes_over_the_years-1.png)

``` r

Final_Data %>%
  subset(ColNames=="No of Rejected Votes" & Electorate=="Final District Results") %>%
  group_by(Year,ColNames) %>%
  summarise(Votes=sum(Votes)/100000) %>%
  ungroup(Year,ColNames) %>%
  ggplot(.,aes(Year,Votes,label=Votes))+
  geom_col()+geom_text(vjust=1)+
  ylab("Votes (in 100,000)")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = years)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+scale_color_viridis_d()+
  ggtitle("No of Rejected Votes Over the Years")
```

![](reference/figures/Rejected_Votes_over_the_years-1.png)

## Conclusion

Complete information about how the data was scraped from the pdf files
are available at the github repository [Presidential Election
Data](https://github.com/Amalan-ConStat/PresidentialElection). Read this
blog post [“Extract Presidential Election Data of 2015 from the Pdf
file”](https://amalan-con-stat.netlify.app/post/slelection/presidential-election/2015/2015/)
for a clear picture of how to scrape the data from pdf files. Results of
all elections occured in Sri Lanka are available at the [Election
Commission website](https://elections.gov.lk/)

# Package index

## Election Data

Sri Lankan presidential election results for eight elections from 1982
to 2019.

- [`Election1982`](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/reference/Election1982.md)
  : Presidential Election 1982
- [`Election1988`](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/reference/Election1988.md)
  : Presidential Election 1988
- [`Election1994`](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/reference/Election1994.md)
  : Presidential Election 1994
- [`Election1999`](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/reference/Election1999.md)

# Articles

### Data Extraction and Preparation

Year-specific documentation of data extraction, count corrections,
percentage calculations, missing-value handling, and label
harmonisation. The 2019 article also documents the OCR prompt, missing
and misplaced result tables, and preserved registered-elector
discrepancies.

- [1982 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-1982.md):
- [1988 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-1988.md):
- [1994 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-1994.md):
- [1999 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-1999.md):
- [2005 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-2005.md):
- [2010 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-2010.md):
- [2015 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-2015.md):
- [2019 Presidential Election: Data
  Preparation](https://amalan-constat.github.io/SLPresElection/articles/election-2019.md):
